questions.text:
A rod of length L and mass M is hinged at point O. A small bullet of mass m hits the rod 
as shown in the figure. The bullet gets embedded in the rod. Find angular velocity of the 
system just after impact.

An observer standing on a railway crossing receives frequencies of 2.2 kHz and 1.8 kHz 
when the train approaches and recedes from the observer. Find the velocity of the train. 
[the speed of the sound in air is 300 m/s].

A U-shaped tube contains a liquid of density r and it is rotated about the line as shown in 
the figure. Find the difference in the levels of liquid column.

A conducting bubble of radius a, thickness t (t < < a) has potential V. Now the bubble 
collapses into a droplet. Find the potential of the droplet.

The potential energy of a particle varies as  
            U (x) = E0 0 < x < 1  
                    = 0 x > 1  
For 0 < x < 1. de Broglie wavelength is l1 and for x > 1 the de Broglie wavelength isl2. 
Total energy of the particle is 2E0. Find l1/l2 .

AB and CD are two slabs. The medium between the slabs has refractive index 2. Find the 
minimum angle of incidence at Q so that the ray is totally reflected by both the slabs.

The edge of a cube is measured using a vernier caliper. [9 divisions of the main scale is 
equal to 10 divisions of vernier scale and 1 main scale division is 1 mm]. The main scale 
division reading is 10 and 1 division of vernier scale was found to be coinciding with the 
main scale. The mass of the cube is 2.736 g. Calculate the density in g/cm3 upto correct 
significant figures.

R1, R2, R3 are different values of R. A, B, C are the null points obtained corresponding to 
R1, R2 and R3 respectively. For which resistor, the value of X will be the most accurate and 
why?

A solid cylinder rolls without slipping on an inclined plane inclined at an angle q.Find the 
linear acceleration of the cylinder. Mass of the cylinder is M.

At t = 0, switch S is closed. The charge on the capacitor is varying with time as 
Q = Q0 (1 – e–at). Obtain the value of Q0 and a in the given circuit parameters.
A ray of light is incident on a prism ABC of refractive index √3 as shown in figure.

options.A: Find the angle of incidence for which the deviation of light ray by the prism ABC is minimum.
options.B: By what angle the second prism must be rotated, so that the final ray suffer net minimum deviation.

questions.text:
A harmonically moving transverse wave on a string has a maximum particle velocity 
and acceleration of 3 m/s and 90 m/s2 respectively. Velocity of the wave is 20 m/s. Find the 
waveform.

X-rays are incident on a target metal atom having 30 neutrons. The ratio of atomic 
radius of the target atom and 24He is (14)1/3.

options.A: Find the atomic number of target atom.
options.B: Find the frequency of Ka line emitted by this metal. R = 1.1 × 107 m–1, c = 3 × 108 m/s

questions.text:
A long solenoid has n turns per unit length and radius a. A current I = I0 sin wt flows 
through it. A cylindrical vessel of radius R, length L, thickness d(d < < R) and resistivity r is 
kept coaxially as shown in the figure. Find they induced current in the outer cylindrical 
vessel.

Two identical ladders are arranged as shown in the figure. Mass of each ladder is M and 
length L. The system is in equilibrium. Find direction and magnitude of frictional force acting 

 
 
at A or B.

A mass m is undergoing SHM in the vertical direction about the mean position y0with 
amplitude A and angular frequency w. At a distance y from the mean position, the mass 
detaches from the spring. Assume that the spring contracts and does not obstruct y 
(measured from the mean position) such that the height h attained by the block is 
maximum. (Aw2 > g).

A metal of mass 1 kg at constant atmospheric pressure and at initial temperature 20oC 
is given a heat of 20,000 J. Find the following :

options.C: Change in internal energy ( Given : Specific heat 400 J/kg/ oC, coefficient of cubical expansion, g = 9 × 10–5/ oC, density r = 9000 kg/m3, atmospheric pressure = 105 N/m2)

questions.text:
A moving coil galvanometer experiences torque = ki where i is current. If N coils of area 
A each and moment of inertia I is kept in magnetic field B.

options.A: find k in terms of given parameters
options.B: if for current i deflection is π/2, find out torsional constant of spring,
options.C: if a charge Q is passed suddenly through the galvanometer find out maximum angle of deflection.
